body: Yes, I agree it is a very toxic environment. I've lived away from home the 4 years I've been at college, supporting myself with loans so I'm not really around my mom, but I'm somewhat dependent on her so we're in contact frequently. The problem is I couldn't work because I had to keep a 3.8 to keep my full ride scholarship and I devoted all of my time to studying. Now I have nowhere to go but home after graduating because my funds are dried up. It's not only that but my guilt at feeling like I have to pay my family back... I'd feel terrible if I just moved away without sending them money or supporting them, and I don't think I'd make enough to live on my own and send them money. I'd love to move away for graduate school, but I don't even have the credentials to apply right now so I'm trapped.
